name: The Caravan Cafe
source:
The Caravan Cafe travels around the Lapis Garden giving out it's specialized Mood Brew to customers. The Hopp family that owns it hasn't settled down just yet, but perhaps they finally found their new home?

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/the-caravan-cafe]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大篷车咖啡馆遍布青金石花园，为顾客提供专业的心情啤酒。拥有它的霍普家族还没有安定下来，但也许他们终于找到了新家？

[来自[url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/the-caravan-cafe]Itch.io[/url]]
